authorization: User approved <=20 canonical candidates and <=100 related alias/team-membership rows; read-only Podkolzin/Nugent-Hopkins/RNH trial evidence only.

queries.sql:
WITH player_candidates AS (
  SELECT id, "fullName", "lastName", position
  FROM public.players
  WHERE "fullName" ILIKE '%podkolzin%'
     OR "fullName" ILIKE '%nugent%hopkins%'
     OR "lastName" ILIKE '%podkolzin%'
     OR "lastName" ILIKE '%nugent%hopkins%'
  ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
), registry_candidates AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.nhl_player_id, i.canonical_name, i.last_name, i.canonical_position, i.verification_status
  FROM public.fhfh_player_identities AS i
  WHERE i.canonical_name ILIKE '%podkolzin%'
     OR i.canonical_name ILIKE '%nugent%hopkins%'
     OR i.last_name ILIKE '%podkolzin%'
     OR i.last_name ILIKE '%nugent%hopkins%'
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.fhfh_player_identity_aliases AS a
       WHERE a.fhfh_player_id = i.id AND lower(trim(a.alias)) = 'rnh'
     )
  ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(p ORDER BY p.id), '[]'::json) FROM player_candidates p) AS players,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(i ORDER BY i.id), '[]'::json) FROM registry_candidates i) AS identities;

WITH registry_aliases AS (
  SELECT id, fhfh_player_id, alias, verification_status
  FROM public.fhfh_player_identity_aliases
  WHERE fhfh_player_id IN (9521,10190) OR lower(trim(alias)) = 'rnh'
  ORDER BY id LIMIT 40
), lineup_aliases AS (
  SELECT alias, player_id, team_id
  FROM public.lineup_player_name_aliases
  WHERE player_id IN (8476454,8481617) OR lower(trim(alias)) = 'rnh'
  ORDER BY player_id, alias, team_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 20
), memberships AS (
  SELECT "playerId", "teamId", "seasonId", created_at, ended_at, is_current
  FROM public.rosters
  WHERE "playerId" IN (8476454,8481617) AND "seasonId" = 20262027
  ORDER BY "playerId", created_at, "teamId" LIMIT 40
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.id), '[]'::json) FROM registry_aliases a) AS registry_aliases,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.player_id, a.alias, a.team_id), '[]'::json) FROM lineup_aliases a) AS lineup_aliases,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r ORDER BY r."playerId", r.created_at, r."teamId"), '[]'::json) FROM memberships r) AS memberships;

notes: No SELECT *, private league/account fields, writes, refreshes, provider requests or credential operations.
Registry and NHL IDs remain separate.
Each returned collection was strictly below its query limit. Directory remains partial; no global completeness claim.
